name: Alternating Incline Inner Biceps Curl

cues: One side works while the other holds still at the start; switch every rep.

faults.fix: Go lighter and stand still as a post while the handle travels.
Keep the elbows by your pockets; only the handle travels.

name: Supported Dumbbell Lunges
setup: Split stance, feet hip-width apart side to side, holding a dumbbell.
cues: Hold a post or the wall lightly with one hand: it steadies you, it does not lift you.
Drive the floor down through your front heel.
Drop the back knee straight down toward the floor like an elevator.

faults.fix: Push the front knee out over your laces.
Set the feet on two train tracks on the floor, hip-width apart.

name: Supported Single-Leg High Box Squat
setup: Stand on one leg in front of a box or bench, the other leg reaching forward or back, arms out for balance.
cues: Hold a post or the wall lightly with one hand: it steadies you, it does not lift you.
Sit back toward the box slowly and touch it without dropping.
Keep the standing knee travelling out over your laces.

faults.fix: Lower on a slow three-count and kiss the box.
Push the knee out over your laces the whole rep.

cautions: Raise the box until every rep is controlled.
